AzureIntune.DescriptionField: Enable the use of Azure Intune for the Omnia app. This should only be used in conjunction with the 'Use Omnia Entra ID App for Omnia Feed' feature.

UseOmniaApp.Title: Use Omnia Entra ID App for Omnia Feed
UseOmniaApp.Description: Enable the use of the Omnia Entra ID App instead of the Omnia Feed Entra ID app.
